name: Murasaki Hayato
source:
"'I think so.' That's enough reason for me to laugh."

People affectionately call him "Hayato-senpai" regardless of the grade they're in. He's a handsome guy who is reasonable when he keeps quiet, but his behavior and the way he is treated by those around him are unfortunate.

Image color: Purple
Image flower: Bellflower, purple rose

[Translated from [url=https://note.com/nananote07/n/nee97c8c75aa2]Note[/url]]
